The Harmonious Fusion of Traditional Vedic Wisdom, Precision Panchanga, and Modern Tech

Glow Date is a high-precision Vedic calendar, Panchanga, and astrological companion designed for modern daily life. Seamlessly bridging Bikram Sambat (BS), Nepal Sambat, and the Gregorian calendar (AD), it delivers exact astronomical coordinates tailored to your exact geographical position.
1. Auspicious Timing for Key Actions (Choghadiya & Hora)
Plan contracts, financial investments, official meetings, and travel during auspicious Choghadiya windows (Amrit, Shubh, Labh) while steering clear of unfavorable periods like Rahu Kalam.
Align daily decisions with real-time planetary transits and Moon signs to enhance productivity, balance emotional well-being, and optimize personal interactions.
Receive accurate start and end timings for Tithis, Ekadashi fasts, Purnima, Sankranti, and cultural holidays to prepare ceremonies with complete confidence.
4. Official Date Synchronization (BS to AD Converter)
Instantly convert dates between Bikram Sambat and Gregorian calendars for administrative paperwork, banking transactions, legal documentation, and official records.
Powered by the Swiss Ephemeris engine using the Chitra Paksha (Lahiri) Ayanamsha, all calculations dynamically adjust to your precise latitude, longitude, and elevation.
